execution.limits: All started CLI attempts count, including provider/auth failures, timeout, capture/parse failure and verifier unknown. Parent-process time is measured separately from verifier time; child CPU/RSS if captured is local CLI, never remote model GPU or backend memory. Fixed CLI invocation count and wall limits bound this pilot; monetary/subscription usage is unknown rather than guessed from tokens.
